title_html: How the TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace Actually Works, Move by Move
description: The TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace only moves GMV when sourcing, seeding cadence, and commission structure run in order. Here's how the mechanics work.
dek: For a brand already doing real volume, the Creator Marketplace isn't a tool you check once a week. It's a bench: who you source, how often you seed them, what they earn, and when their content is proven enough to hand to GMV Max.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Build a creator bench that actually moves GMV.
llms_summary: How the TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace works in practice for an established brand: sourcing criteria (proven sell-through, category and language fit), seeding cadence (targeted sampling over spray-and-pray), the two-tier commission structure (open affiliate rate vs. a retainer layer of guaranteed content budget for proven performers), and the handoff of organically-proven content into GMV Max - anchored to three real affiliate and creator-seeding case studies (personal care, baby and maternity, health and wellness supplements).
